historical_references.reference: Ibn Khaldun records the name Musedat as the capital city of the Banu Hilal Confederacy during the 14th century.
historical_references.context: Musedat was the political and cultural center of the Banu Hilal, a nomadic confederacy that swept across North Africa during the Middle Ages.

historical_references.reference: Al-Maqrizi mentions Musedat as a significant settlement in Old Cairo during the Fatimid Caliphate (969-1171 AD).
historical_references.context: Musedat was a prosperous agricultural town in the heart of Old Cairo, known for its palm gardens and agricultural productivity.
